name: Rei
source:
Rei is a humanoid feeling robot called Phiroid that is awakened inside an decayed facility. Rei's development probably hasn't finished since his right hand is not covered with artifical skin, and is showing the mechanical parts. He finds out that an important program that responsible for him to show "feelings", is missing from him.
